subject: PO authorization freeze, weekly statement sync, and discount eligibility mapping
messages:
From: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@greennet.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@greennet.com>
Date: 2027-10-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: PO template and billing cadence for Redwood engagement

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — GreenNet is excited to move forward. Finance asked me to send our standard PO template (attached) and outline a few procurement constraints so we can kick off vendor setup: 

- We require a PO number on every invoice and a PO header field called "billing_entity" to map to our ledger.
- Preferred invoice cadence: weekly consolidated statement (one summary invoice per week) with line items split by environment (prod/test).
- Net terms: default is net60. We can consider net45 if Redwood can provide an early-invoice for onboarding credits (one-time).
- Discount eligibility: our procurement system only passes discount flags to vendors when the PO has the "commitment_level" value populated (values: trial, standard, committed).
- Cutover target: vendor onboarding completed and first invoice accepted by 2027-10-15.

Can your billing/legal confirm whether the PO header requirement and weekly statement are compatible with Redwood's billing flows and whether discount slabs can be mapped to a PO field?

Attachment: GreenNet_PO_Template_v2.pdf (application/pdf)

Appreciate a quick reply — procurement needs these answers to include Redwood in this quarter's purchasing wave.

Thanks,
Sarah Lim
Senior Procurement Manager
GreenNet Energy
[sarah.lim@greennet.com]

On Thu, 30 Sep 2027 at 16:00, Naomi Feldman wrote:
> Thanks for the call — looking forward to working together.

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@greennet.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-03T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO template and billing cadence for Redwood engagement

Hi Sarah —

Thanks for the PO and the clear constraints. I've looped in Vanessa (AE), Ben (billing) and Priyom (legal) to confirm feasibility. Quick answers up front:

- PO number on each invoice: yes, we can populate the PO field on line-level and invoice header.
- "billing_entity" header: we can map a custom PO header to our ledger tags, but need to confirm the exact key name your ERP expects to avoid mapping mismatches. Can you confirm exact JSON/key label or a screenshot of the PO header?
- Weekly consolidated statement: our standard hosted billing runs daily token-level billing; we can produce a weekly consolidated PDF/statement for AP, but we need to confirm two things: 1) whether GreenNet expects invoices dated on the week-end or the invoice run-date, and 2) whether you require one invoice per legal entity or a single consolidated invoice across entities.
- Discount flag mapping: Ben — does our billing pipeline support honor-based discount flags derived from a PO meta-field? Priyom — any contractual caveats tying discounts to PO meta-fields vs. signed SOW?

We want to avoid a discount being auto-applied based only on a PO field without contractual confirmation. If GreenNet can confirm commitment_level in the PO and have a signed SOW or MOU that defines the slab, we should be fine operationally.

Proposed next steps: Vanessa will send a mutual action plan (MAP) with the timeline; Ben will send a one-page invoice-mapping example, and Priyom will flag any redlines for the PO acceptance language. If you can share the exact PO header screenshot, that will speed mapping.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
aomi_feldman@redwood.com

[Attachment: none]

From: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@greennet.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@greennet.com>, AP Team <ap@greennet.com>
Date: 2027-10-03T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO template and billing cadence for Redwood engagement

Hi Naomi,

Thanks — answered inline below: 

- "billing_entity" key: our ERP expects the field exactly as "billing_entity" (lowercase with underscore). I've attached a screenshot of the PO header export and included a text sample below.
- Weekly statement: GreenNet's AP prefers invoices to be dated on Sunday of the week and consolidated by legal entity. For cross-entity customers we can accept vendor-side consolidation only if the vendor provides weekly breakdowns per entity (ledger tag required).
- Discount slab: Procurement can populate "commitment_level=committed" on the PO if a signed SOW is provided. We intend to have a signed SOW prior to the first invoice (targeting 10/12).
- Net terms: preference is net60. If Redwood is able to provide a one-time early invoice for onboarding credits (due within 15 days), we can accept net60 for recurring invoices.

We are under a tight timeline — cutover must be complete by 2027-10-15 to align with our monthly close. If Redwood needs legal sign-off on PO acceptance language, we can fast-track review with our procurement counsel.

Attachment: PO_header_screenshot.png (image/png)

Regards,
Sarah

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@greennet.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-03T12:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO template and billing cadence for Redwood engagement

Hi Sarah — copying the proposed billing compromise here so procurement has something concrete for AP: 

1) PO header mapping: we'll accept "billing_entity" as the canonical key and map it to our ledger tag in the invoice line metadata. Please confirm the possible values for that field (entity IDs).

2) Weekly statement: Redwood will produce a consolidated weekly statement dated on the Sunday of the week. Each statement will include per-entity breakdown rows (legal_entity_id column) so your ERP can ingest.

3) Net terms & onboarding: we can accept net60 for recurring invoices with one exception — Redwood will issue a one-time onboarding invoice (up to $25k) dated on execution that will be payable net15. After 90 days of production, we re-evaluate cadence (standardizing to net60 thereafter).

4) Discount application: technical mapping is possible, but discounts will only be applied if contract/SAAS SOW references the commitment_level and the billing system receives the confirmed value in the PO. We will not auto-apply discounts solely based on an unverified PO field.

Attachment: invoice_mapping_example.csv (text/csv) — sample columns: invoice_id, invoice_date, po_number, billing_entity, legal_entity_id, line_item_desc, amount, discount_flag

If that looks acceptable I can route to operations to add GreenNet to the weekly billing run. Naomi/Vanessa — please confirm and I will create the onboarding invoice once we have a signed SOW.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Director, Revenue Operations
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@greennet.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-03T14:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO template and billing cadence for Redwood engagement

Hi Sarah and team — quick legal note from my side: 

- We can accept the PO as an operational instrument to trigger billing provided the PO acknowledgement language includes a clause that discounts are contingent on a signed SOW that defines commitment levels. 
- Please confirm GreenNet's preferred signature flow for the SOW (DocuSign link vs. countersigned PDF) so we can align timelines. 
- Naomi/Vanessa: please include the following sentence in the MAP: "GreenNet will provide a signed SOW prior to acceptance of discount slabs; Redwood will not apply discount rates without a signed SOW and verified PO metadata." I'll draft a redline for the PO acceptance paragraph and send it by EOD.

If procurement needs a tracked redline, share the PO JSON export from your ERP and I'll mark up the acceptance text.

Best,
Priyom Das
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com
